name: Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2)
short_description: Enveloped +ssRNA betacoronavirus (SARS-CoV-2): a ~80–120 nm sphere with a crown of club-shaped Spike (S) trimers, M and E envelope proteins, and a helical nucleocapsid (N + single RNA strand).

textbook.1: ✅ PASS — enveloped sphere with sparse club-shaped Spike corona, M/E dots in the envelope, cutaway showing beaded N protein around a single coiled RNA; no face/cell, RNA single strand.
textbook.2: ✅ PASS — re-rendered in the refined rod-bacterium/parasite textbook style: muted desaturated palette, thin outlines, soft shading.

sem.1: ✅ PASS — single warm-false-color virion, sparse club-shaped spike corona over a smooth envelope; surface only, no internal structure.

3d.1: ✅ PASS — iconic look: translucent grey-blue envelope, red club-shaped Spike trimers, golden M/E dots, cutaway showing the golden helical nucleocapsid (N + coiled RNA).

watercolor.1: ❌ FAIL — cream mat/frame around an olive background (not full-bleed).
watercolor.2: ✅ PASS — warm cream paper fills the frame; spike corona, envelope M/E dots, single coiled RNP; no frame/text/DNA.

reference: ✅ PASS — genuine NIAID-RML colorized TEM of SARS-CoV-2 virions with clearly resolved Spike coronae (CC BY 2.0, Public via Flickr); no baked-in text. An AI clean-up that re-illustrated it was discarded to keep the reference authentic.
